description.short: Ecommerce conversion, checkout, error and experiment insights from Noibu
description.full: Connect Noibu to Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork to analyze store health, checkout, products, traffic segments, technical errors and Core Web Vitals, accessibility, and A/B testing (finding, building and launching tests) using your own Noibu data. Ten workflows: Noibu Setup, Querying Noibu Data, Store Pulse, Checkout Analysis, Product Analysis, Segment Analysis, Technical Diagnosis, Accessibility Audit, Build Business Context and A/B Testing. Reports appear as an interactive board when the Noibu report widget is available, with actions to investigate findings, save a report to OneDrive, download a PDF, save a private Cowork app snapshot, schedule refreshed reports, open tickets, create A/B test drafts and build A/B tests through a pull request or Shopify preview theme. Every write, send, schedule or share needs your confirmation; each user signs in to Noibu individually and sees only the stores their Noibu account can access.

agentConnectors.description: Noibu ecommerce analytics: sessions, conversion, page visits, errors, performance, business context and A/B tests for the stores your Noibu account can access.
